purpose: Rules for converting inherited/curated source categories into structured metadata, mentions, compilation membership, material evidence, and genuine taxonomy. Simplified-to-Traditional normalization uses OpenCC s2t by default; Unihan remains an explicit diagnostic fallback only.

safe_remove_rules.name: transcription_percentage
safe_remove_rules.note: Wikisource transcription percentages are stale workflow state and are not reliable enough to retain.

safe_remove_rules.name: public_domain_marker
safe_remove_rules.note: The corpus makes its own public-domain determination; inherited PD-old categories are redundant.

safe_remove_rules.name: public_domain_label_zh
safe_remove_rules.pattern: (?:公有領域|公有领域|公共領域|公共领域)
safe_remove_rules.note: Inherited public-domain labels are licensing/provenance state, not content taxonomy; the corpus makes its own public-domain determination.

safe_remove_rules.name: wiki_workflow_state
safe_remove_rules.pattern: ^(?:待完之篇|待譯之篇|待译之篇|求驗|求验|求詳|求详|待新之篇|未用之事|既失之版|未廣佈之版|未广布之版|空商賈之錄|空商贾之录|闕段之文|缺段之文|闕實體棨信|缺实体.*)$
safe_remove_rules.note: Source-wiki maintenance state is not content taxonomy.

safe_remove_rules.name: unknown_ai_version_outlier
safe_remove_rules.note: Isolated malformed technical category; no literary or metadata value has been identified.

safe_remove_rules.name: wiki_page_maintenance_labels
safe_remove_rules.pattern: ^(?:校訂不足的頁面|校订不足的页面|需要清理的頁面|需要清理的页面|需要拆分的頁面|需要拆分的页面|含有受損文件鏈接的頁面|含有受损文件链接的页面|大中華地區有版權爭議的頁面|大中华地区有版权争议的页面)$
safe_remove_rules.note: Source-wiki page maintenance/licensing state is not content taxonomy.

safe_remove_rules.name: ai_initial_punctuation_note
safe_remove_rules.pattern: ^(?:初始標點是人工智能程序創建|初始标点是人工智能程序创建)$
safe_remove_rules.note: Processing/provenance note about machine-generated punctuation; it should not be a content category.

safe_remove_rules.name: inherited_license_marker
safe_remove_rules.note: Inherited Wikisource licence/status categories are not content taxonomy. The corpus makes its own public-domain determination for each text.

safe_remove_rules.name: source_disambiguation_marker
safe_remove_rules.note: Source-wiki disambiguation state is not content taxonomy.

safe_remove_rules.name: representative_work_editorial
safe_remove_rules.note: Source-side editorial selection (“representative work”) is not content taxonomy.

scoped_keep_rules.name: minecraft_technical_taxonomy
scoped_keep_rules.pattern: (?:爪哇版|基石版|基岩版|啟者|启者|快照|測版|测版|伺服端|服务器|教育版|攜帶版|携带版|資囊|资囊|數錄|数录|History模)
scoped_keep_rules.work_scope_pattern: (?:Minecraft|我的世界|當個創世神|当个创世神|礦藝大典|矿艺大典|爪哇版|基岩版|基石版)
scoped_keep_rules.note: Keep Minecraft-specific organisation inside the Minecraft corpus scope; hide it from ordinary corpus browsing instead of deleting it.

scoped_keep_rules.name: minecraft_section_taxonomy
scoped_keep_rules.note: Keep source taxonomy inside the Minecraft/礦藝大典 section and hide it from unrelated corpus browsing.

scoped_keep_rules.name: asdc_oracle_bone_source_taxonomy
scoped_keep_rules.pattern: ^(?:雨|告|用|王貞|祝貞|史貞|隊貞|師貞)$
scoped_keep_rules.work_scope_pattern: (?:inscription\.asdc\.sinica\.edu\.tw|先秦甲骨金文簡牘詞彙資料庫|ASDC｜|合集[0-9]|新收NA)
scoped_keep_rules.note: Preserve these source-specific oracle-bone/ASDC classification labels for research and scope them to the excavated-text/inscriptional browse context. Their technical semantics should be mapped separately before any global ontology promotion.

archaeological_contexts: 周家莊（龍山時代；聖水牛存在並被利用）

sources.citation: 中央研究院歷史語言研究所歷史文物陳列館. (n.d.). 什麼叫做「甲骨文」？ Retrieved August 28, 2026, from https://museum.sinica.edu.tw/resources/item/63/
sources.note: 史語所教學資源明確指出商代卜骨多用牛胛骨，並稱聖水牛肩胛骨為卜骨的重要來源；因此 Bubalus mephistopheles 應列為已確認的卜骨動物，不應因單一研究樣本未驗出而降格。

sources.citation: Pei, Xiaochen, Liang, Fawei, Cao, Yanpeng, & Zhang, Yunan. (2024). The dynamics of Bovini exploitation strategies on the Central Plains of China from the Middle Neolithic to the Bronze Age. Scientific Reports, 14, 29616. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-81065-y
sources.note: 綜述指出晚商殷墟水牛進入祭祀／特權物品體系，並舉水牛肋骨製作卜骨為例。這是水牛作為卜骨原料的獨立證據。

sources.citation: Brunson, Katherine, Zhao, Xin, He, Nu, Dai, Xiangming, Rodrigues, Antonia, & Yang, Dongya. (2016). New insights into the origins of oracle bone divination: Ancient DNA from Late Neolithic Chinese bovines. Journal of Archaeological Science, 74, 35–44. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jas.2016.08.008
sources.note: 古 DNA 證實周家莊存在並利用 Bubalus mephistopheles；該研究只說其抽樣的卜骨未驗出水牛，不是否定其他地點或其他研究中已確認的水牛卜骨。

sources.citation: Shan, Yuchen 單育辰. (2015). 說「兕」「象」——「甲骨文所見的動物」之六. 饒宗頤國學院院刊, 2, 41–53.
sources.note: 論證甲骨文所見「兕」為水牛，並援引殷墟聖水牛遺存；這支持其在商代甲骨文化中的動物學與名物學背景。

sources.citation: Liang, Xue-Yuan, Liu, Xin-Meng, Lei, Xiao-Le, Hu, Qingbo, Guo, Xiaoning, Song, Shu, Yu, Chong, Yue, Haiyan, Wang, Yiwen, Zhang, Jiangyue, Zhou, Xu, Wang, Hua, Ma, Lijuan, Zhang, Hai, Mo, Linheng, Sun, Guoping, Liu, Li, Chen, Xingcan, Qin, Xiaoli, & Yu, He. (2026). Ancient mitogenomes reveal the genetic relationship among extinct and extant water buffaloes. iScience, 29(7), 116354. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.isci.2026.116354
sources.note: 現代古基因組研究提供 Bubalus mephistopheles 的分類背景；物件級辨識仍應由具體考古或動物考古證據支持。

material_detail_fields.species_input_note: The planner accepts a scientific name, Chinese common name, English common name, or a full triplet such as Mauremys mutica / 黃喉擬水龜 / Yellow pond turtle and normalizes a unique registry match to material.species.
